body:
# Windows POS 1.0.9+18

- Add Upcharge Prices below Price Breakdown on the drop-off screen.
- Remember the checkbox locally on this PC across application restarts.
- Checked: print general store-copy upcharges on separate lines with unit prices and quantities.
- Unchecked: combine general upcharges with commas and omit their prices.
- Preserve existing detailed store-copy output for parenthesized options, Sample/Belt/Starch exceptions, and repairs.
- Customer-copy option prices remain hidden; existing customer totals and price-breakdown rules are unchanged.
